proposals: Daylight-dropout days: a counter-wide rule that sets a day missing for every zone of a camera when the camera reads 0 in every zone for 8 or more 15-minute slots between 07:00 and 19:00. Where: counter 284 (applied here by hand as per-day missing ranges). Why: the camera fails in daylight on about 200 days; a rule would also cover data arriving after this review (it recurs in Sep-Nov of 2023, 2024 and 2025).

Automatic phantom-burst detection for camera footpath zones: set missing the slots of spike runs not matched by the camera's road zones. Where: 380 and 375 (applied here by hand to runs of 60 or more bikes as slot-range missing decisions). Why: bursts keep occurring after this review, and the smaller runs (20-59 bikes, often one slot) could not be judged by hand.

useful: counter_days: showed the whole camera's daily and weekly totals, exposing the outages, the Jan-Mar 2025 collapse and the Nov 2024 jump
zeros(counter=True): showed that the camera-wide zero runs are daytime (about 09:00-18:00) with counts at dawn and dusk, i.e. daylight detection failures
compare: a steady 377/163 ratio of about 0.45 showed the Nov 2024-Jan 2025 doubling and the dropout weeks against independent tubes
spikes: located the phantom bursts on footpath zones 380 and 375
slots (pivoted wide): confirmed that bursts in one zone have no matching flow in the connecting zones
not_useful: spikes (default thresholds): 2240 runs, dominated by small 20-bike runs in zones whose median is dragged to about 1 by the long dropout periods; hard to read without filtering
improve: spikes: add a column with the same slots' total in the camera's other zones, so phantom bursts (not matched elsewhere) stand out from real groups
zeros(counter=True): add a per-day summary (zero slots between 07:00 and 19:00) so partial daylight dropouts are easier to list
monthly: add a total across a site's directions, as the per-direction wide table needed pivoting by hand
add: A per-day camera health table: counter-wide zero slots in daytime, midday vs peak ratio, and slots published, so dropout days can be listed directly
A tool to split one counter-direction into separate series at a date (e.g. a reconfiguration), for camera steps like the Nov 2024 one

summary: Camera C0000801 at Bronte Rd / Oxford St, Bondi Junction (10 zones, 20 directions) has two outages and about 200 days where it stops detecting in daylight, so every zone reads 0 through the middle of the day. Those days, and a near-total failure from mid-January to April 2025, are set missing, and zero-filling covers the zero slots the feed has left out since June 2025. Phantom bursts on footpath zones 380 and 375 are set missing slot by slot. The doubled level from Nov 2024 to Jan 2025 against nearby tubes is split into its own series per direction.
